title: Validate reconnect recovery during a physical PP1 sew-out
description: Software verification passed for reconnect recovery, color-change polling, saved artwork, rotation/placement and IndexedDB cache recovery. During a real multi-color print in Bluefy, interrupt Bluetooth, reconnect, and verify the current stitch and color step match the PP1. Repeat at a color change and after refreshing the page. This hardware check cannot be completed by the automated mock-service tests.
